summary: All actionable round-1 findings are resolved cleanly with no regressions. EmailService now passes the throwable as the trailing SLF4J argument so the full stack trace is appended on ERROR while preserving the spec-pinned message format the test asserts on; HttpRequestUtilsTest dropped the unneeded lenient() and strengthened the anti-instantiation gate from canAccess to Modifier.isPrivate; the optional Javadoc note in HttpRequestUtils was intentionally not acted on (acceptable — the round-1 finding was marked optional). Acceptance grep gates still hold: no Mono/Flux/reactor in UserService, no reactor.* in user/events/email packages, no logEventBlocking in EventService.
